summary: Tested premium dashboard features: Daily Rhythm Report + Hormone Map. Both backend endpoints (/api/premium/daily-rhythm, /api/premium/hormone-map) and frontend UI components pass all tests. 12/12 backend tests and all frontend verifications passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2545 lines — consider splitting into routers (users, cycle, premium, etc.) for maintainability.

Existing dashboard cards (mood prediction, cycle phases, affirmation, do/avoid, nutrition, wellness) do NOT have data-testid attributes — only the two new premium cards do. Adding data-testid to older dashboard components would improve testability for future regression tests.

HormoneMap phase timeline bar segments and legend labels use hardcoded PHASE_COLORS keys (Menstrual/Follicular/Ovulatory/Luteal). If backend later returns extra phase labels (e.g., 'Late'), they will be silently dropped from the timeline visualization.
RHYTHM_DATA is embedded as a large in-code constant (~60 lines). Consider moving to a JSON/yaml resource file to ease content updates without code deploys.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded test user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium endpoints are public (require JWT auth). Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_premium_dashboard.py covers status, structure, 8 rhythm categories, 28-day hormone data, phase labels, today marker, and auth requirement. Frontend: user lands on dashboard after login (hamburger -> Sign In -> form submit). The Sign In button has 2 DOM matches; only the mobile one is visible on mobile viewport — use .is_visible() filter or page.get_by_text('Sign In').nth(1) on mobile. All 15 premium data-testids are present: daily-rhythm-report, rhythm-summary, rhythm-{energy,mood,focus,movement,recovery,self_care,libido,pain}, hormone-map, hormone-chart, hormone-legend-{estrogen,progesterone,lh}. Legend click toggles bg-white/[0.06] class on the active hormone button — verified visually and programmatically. Hormone chart renders 6 SVG paths (3 area fills + 3 strokes). Phase timeline (Menstrual/Follicular/Ovulatory/Luteal) and medical disclaimer both render. Existing cycle phase card (e.g., 'Menstrual Phase') still visible below the new premium components.
